question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Impoverished
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 (Rich)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Impoverished"** means being extremely poor or lacking in resources or wealth. (गरीब, निर्धन)

 
 
• **Example:** After the war, the country was left impoverished and struggling to rebuild its economy.
 
 
 
• **"Rich"** refers to having abundant wealth, resources, or material possessions, which is the direct opposite of being impoverished. (धनी, समृद्ध)
 
 
• **Example:** She became rich after starting her successful business venture.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can conclude that the antonym of **"Impoverished"** is **"Rich."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 (Rich)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Shy** (शर्मीला): Being reserved or nervous in the presence of others.

 
 
• **Example:** He was too shy to speak up during the meeting.
 
 
 
• **Humble** (विनम्र): Having a modest or low view of one's importance.
 
 
• **Example:** Despite his success, he remains humble and down-to-earth.
 
 
 
• **Tiny** (छोटा): Extremely small in size.
 
 
• **Example:** The baby held a tiny flower in her hand.
